However, standard CO-22 handling usually means the claim was sent to the wrong payer (the secondary) when it should have gone to the primary, OR the primary has not paid. Given the action 'bill_secondary' is available and the only successful similar claim used 'bill_secondary', and the CO-22 code specifically flags a COB issue, the most logical action to progress the claim is to bill the secondary payer (assuming the primary was already billed or the system interprets 'secondary' as the next step in the COB resolution).
